spells.name: Animal Messenger
spells.summary: Send a Tiny animal to a designated place with a simple message or item.

spells.name: Calm Animals
spells.summary: Soothe animals and magical beasts, making them docile.

spells.name: Charm Animal
spells.summary: Make one animal regard you as a trusted friend and ally.

spells.name: Detect Animals or Plants
spells.summary: Sense a chosen kind of animal or plant within the spell's area.

spells.name: Detect Snares and Pits
spells.summary: Reveal natural and primitive hazards along your path.

spells.name: Hide from Animals
spells.summary: Prevent animals from sensing the warded creatures.

spells.name: Longstrider
spells.summary: Increase your base land speed for an extended duration.

spells.name: Magic Fang
spells.summary: Give one natural weapon a magical enhancement bonus.

spells.name: Pass without Trace
spells.summary: Let the subjects move without leaving tracks or a scent trail.

spells.name: Speak with Animals
spells.summary: Communicate with animals and ask them questions.

spells.name: Summon Nature's Ally I
spells.summary: Summon a natural creature to fight for you.

spells.name: Barkskin
spells.summary: Toughen a creature's skin to grant a natural armor bonus.

spells.name: Hold Animal
spells.summary: Paralyze one animal for a short time.

spells.name: Snare
spells.summary: Create a magical trap from a supple cord or vine.

spells.name: Speak with Plants
spells.summary: Communicate with normal plants and plant creatures.

spells.name: Spike Growth
spells.summary: Transform ground cover into concealed spikes that injure and slow creatures.

spells.name: Summon Nature's Ally II
spells.summary: Summon a stronger natural creature or several lesser allies.

spells.name: Command Plants
spells.summary: Influence plant creatures and direct their actions.

spells.name: Diminish Plants
spells.summary: Reduce normal vegetation or temporarily inhibit its growth.

spells.name: Magic Fang, Greater
spells.summary: Grant magical enhancement to a creature's natural weapons.

spells.name: Plant Growth
spells.summary: Enrich plants or cause vegetation to become thick and overgrown.

spells.name: Reduce Animal
spells.summary: Shrink one willing animal and reduce its physical power.

spells.name: Remove Disease
spells.summary: Cure diseases affecting the touched creature.

spells.name: Repel Vermin
spells.summary: Create a barrier that keeps vermin at a distance.

spells.name: Summon Nature's Ally III
spells.summary: Summon a more powerful natural creature or several lesser allies.

spells.name: Tree Shape
spells.summary: Assume the form of a living tree or shrub.

spells.name: Water Walk
spells.summary: Allow subjects to tread across liquid surfaces.

spells.name: Commune with Nature
spells.summary: Learn about the surrounding terrain, creatures, and natural features.

spells.name: Summon Nature's Ally IV
spells.summary: Summon a powerful natural creature or several lesser allies.
